key_insight: A nondimensionalized morphoelastic burn-healing model links maximum wound contraction mainly to individual parameters, but contraction timing and permanent contracture to higher-order interactions.
engineering_relevance: Neglecting chemotaxis and inertia supports a quasi-static formulation that simplifies simulations coupling wound biology with tissue mechanics.
method: Nondimensionalization and scaling analysis identify negligible terms.
FEniCSx finite elements with variational inequalities enforce non-negativity.
Large-scale sensitivity analysis probes parameter effects and interactions.
evidence_signal: The framework was checked through numerical convergence studies and mass balances, with sensitivity analysis spanning nearly four million simulations.
watch_item: Solver stability remains sensitive to higher-order interactions involving equilibrium collagen density and signalling dynamics.
paper_title: Nondimensionalization, Variational Inequalities and Uncertainty Quantification in a Morphoelastic Model for Burn Injury Healing
